name: selvedge
description: Selvedge checks finished work against its brief and reports an evidenced PASS/FAIL per acceptance criterion. Target safety: a committed selvedge.json origin allowlist, env commands with user-approved hooks, a browser guard that refuses unlisted origins, and auth setup (a sign-in kept outside the repo). Criteria to a frozen plan: criteria (extraction, a vague-criterion check), snapshot (an allowed page's accessibility tree) and plan (planner, static lint, sha256-frozen plan.json). Running it: run (no model call; --replay, a redacted --trace) and verdict (per criterion, from evidence alone).
